sources.entry: Imagine - Imagine is a desktop app for compression of PNG and JPEG, with a modern and friendly UI.

summary.one_liner: IMGo is a batch image compression and conversion tool, a rewrite of meowtec/Imagine, available as a Tauri desktop app and as a browser-based web app.
summary.what_it_does: IMGo processes multiple images at once for compression and format conversion. Users can adjust quality, lossless mode, dimensions (resize), and metadata handling. It supports animated PNG, GIF, WebP, and AVIF. The README says processing happens locally, so images are not uploaded. Output formats are JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, and HEIC in the web app, plus JPEG XL (JXL) in the desktop app. Desktop builds are offered for macOS (Apple Silicon or Intel), Windows (ARM64 or x64), and Linux (AppImage, ARM64 or x64), and a browser version needs no installation.
use_cases: batch compress PNG and JPEG files
convert images between formats like WebP and AVIF
optimize images without uploading them online
reduce image file sizes for websites
how_to_run: Use the web version at imgo.app in a browser (no install).
Download the desktop app from GitHub Releases and choose the DMG (macOS), installer (Windows), or AppImage (Linux) matching your system.
If macOS blocks the app, move IMGo.app to Applications, open Terminal, and run: xattr -cr "/Applications/IMGo.app"
Open IMGo again after running the command.
stack: Electron (replaced by Tauri in this version)
notable: Local processing: images stay on the device, per the README
Same tool available as a native desktop app and as a browser web app
Animated PNG, GIF, WebP, and AVIF output supported
JPEG XL output in the desktop version only
caveats: The Windows installer is unsigned and the macOS app is not notarized, so the OS may show a security warning on first open.
The web app and desktop app support different output formats (JXL is desktop-only).
The README describes this as a rewrite of meowtec/Imagine; the original Imagine-plus is suggested for users who want the original UI with more formats.
